rows: Every full-time employee gets 12 Casual Leave (CL), 12 Sick Leave (SL) and 18 Earned Leave (EL) per calendar year. CL and SL are credited on 1 January (pro-rated for joiners) and lapse on 31 December. EL accrues at 1.5 days per month and up to 15 unused EL days carry forward. Interns get 6 CL and 6 SL and no EL. Leave is applied in the HR portal and approved by the reporting manager. Weekends and company holidays inside a leave are not counted. Sick leave of more than 2 consecutive days needs a medical certificate. Leave taken without balance is treated as Loss of Pay (LOP).
Maternity, Paternity and Special Leave Policy

Eligible women employees get 182 calendar days (26 weeks) of paid maternity leave. Fathers get 10 working days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth. Marriage leave is 5 working days, once during employment. Bereavement leave is 3 working days for the loss of an immediate family member. Special leaves are paid and do not reduce CL, SL or EL balances.

The working week is Monday to Friday. The company declares 11 public holidays each year, published in the holiday calendar. Holidays that fall on a weekend are not compensated. Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 and the standard working day is 9 hours including breaks.

Salary is credited on the last working day of each month and the payslip is published in the HR portal on the same day. The attendance and reimbursement cut-off is the 25th of every month; anything approved after the cut-off is paid in the next month's payroll. Salary structure: Basic is 40% of CTC (an intern's stipend is paid entirely as Basic), HRA is 40% of Basic, employer PF, gratuity and insurance are deducted from CTC and the balance is Special Allowance. Loss of Pay deducts one day's gross (monthly gross divided by calendar days in the month) for each LOP day. Professional Tax of Rs 200 per month applies when monthly gross is Rs 15,000 or more.

Employees choose the New or Old tax regime in the HR portal at the start of the financial year; New is the default. TDS is deducted monthly on projected annual income. Investment declarations open in April and proofs must be submitted by 31 January. Form 16 for the previous financial year is issued by 15 June.

Employee and employer each contribute 12% of Basic towards EPF, calculated on a wage ceiling of Rs 15,000 (Rs 1,800 per month each). Interns are not covered. Gratuity accrues at 4.81% of Basic and becomes payable after 5 years of continuous service.

Employer-paid group health cover for the employee, spouse and up to 2 children. Sum insured by level: Fresher and Junior Rs 5,00,000; Mid Rs 7,50,000; Senior and Lead Rs 10,00,000. Cover starts on the date of joining and the e-card is issued within 7 days. New dependents (marriage, birth) must be added within 30 days of the event. Parents can be covered through an optional Parental Top-up of Rs 3,00,000, paid by the employee at Rs 1,100 per month for one parent or Rs 2,100 for two. The open enrollment window is 1 to 15 October each year. Interns are not covered.
Group Term Life and Personal Accident Policy

Employer-paid group term life cover of 3 times annual CTC, capped at Rs 1 crore, and personal accident cover of Rs 10,00,000. Nominees can be updated in the HR portal at any time. Interns are not covered.

Optional benefits: a meal card (up to Rs 2,200 per month) and the NPS employer contribution option. Every full-time employee gets an annual health check-up worth up to Rs 3,000. The Employee Assistance Programme offers free, confidential counselling sessions through an external provider.

Claim limits: Internet Rs 1,000 per month (Hybrid and Remote employees); Mobile Rs 500 per month; Wellness or gym Rs 1,000 per month; Business travel up to Rs 30,000 per claim with prior approval; Client entertainment up to Rs 5,000 per claim; Medical OPD Rs 15,000 per year; Learning Rs 30,000 per year; WFH equipment Rs 25,000 once in 3 years; Relocation Rs 50,000 once for eligible new joiners. Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense (15 days for travel and client entertainment, 60 days for medical, learning and relocation). Original invoices are mandatory; Travel and Client entertainment need receipts for every item above Rs 250. Claims approved by the 25th are paid in that month's payroll.

All business travel needs prior manager approval. Economy class flights and AC train travel are reimbursed at actuals within the Rs 30,000 per-trip limit. Claims with receipts must be submitted within 15 days of returning from the trip.

Each employee has a learning budget of Rs 30,000 per financial year for courses, certifications and books relevant to their role. The manager approves the request and the completion proof is attached to the claim.

Letters are requested in the HR portal and issued as signed PDFs within the SLA (in working days): Payslip copy 1; Appointment letter copy 1; Salary certificate 2; Increment letter copy 2; Form 16 copy 2; Employment verification 3; Address proof 3; Bank loan or bonafide letter 3; NOC 4; Experience letter 5; Visa support 5; Internship certificate 5; Relieving letter 7. Salary, loan and visa letters are issued only to confirmed employees.

Employees earn a referral bonus when a referred candidate joins and completes 90 days: Intern Rs 0, Fresher Rs 10,000, Junior Rs 20,000, Mid Rs 35,000, Senior Rs 50,000, Lead Rs 75,000. HR and the hiring manager of the role are not eligible to claim a bonus on that role.

Full-time employees serve a 6-month probation. Interns have no probation. A confirmation letter is issued within 7 days of the successful review. Salary, loan and visa letters are available only after confirmation.

Notice period by level: Intern 0 days, Fresher 30, Junior 30, Mid 60, Senior 60, Lead 90. Full and final settlement is completed within 45 days of the last working day. Experience and relieving letters are issued after exit clearance.

The annual appraisal cycle takes effect on 1 April. Employees who joined on or before 30 September of the previous year are eligible. Ratings run from 1 to 5 and the guideline increment is 0%, 4%, 8%, 12% and 18% for ratings 1 to 5. Employees with at least one year of service and a rating of 3, 4 or 5 receive a performance bonus in the April payslip of 0.5, 1.0 or 1.5 times monthly Basic.

Hybrid employees work from the office three days a week. Hybrid and Remote employees can claim internet reimbursement of Rs 1,000 per month and a one-time home-office equipment claim of up to Rs 25,000 every 3 years.
Code of Conduct and POSH Policy
All employees must follow the Code of Conduct. Grievances can be raised through the HR helpdesk or directly with the Internal Committee, which handles complaints under the POSH Act confidentially.
Employee Data Privacy and Helpdesk Access Policy

The AI HR Helpdesk answers policy questions for everyone using approved policies only. Personal data such as leave balance, payslips, claims, benefits and documents is shown only to the employee it belongs to. Managers see data of their direct reports only where needed to approve requests. HR administrators can see all data. Every personal-data answer is logged.
